grade_reason: 100% stop-loss hit rate with no profitable trades indicates a complete strategy failure; the agent consistently exits before profit targets are reached.
failure_patterns: Stop-loss triggered on every single trade across all three symbols
No trades reached profit target despite stop-loss being hit
All three asset classes (BTC, ETH, SOL) lost money simultaneously in the same regime
position_sizing: decrease - with 100% loss rate, any position size compounds losses; reduce to 50% until a winning pattern is identified
retrain_focus: Train on high-probability entry signals that allow trades to reach profit targets before stop-loss. Focus on trend-following entries with confirmed momentum rather than mean-reversion strategies.
data_curation_advice: Exclude all past stop-loss exits from training data. Include only trades that reached profit targets. Add data on confirmed breakouts, trend continuation, and momentum-based entries with proper risk-reward ratios.
